title: Generation (qwen-lora-training/generation.json)
description: Shared edit prefix and optional negative for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 dataset rows. prompt is prepended to the ComfyUI edit instruction only; omitted from caption.txt. Not Animagine quality/rating tags.

prompt.description: Identity-preserving prefix for the ComfyUI edit prompt (e.g. keep face and body from the reference image).

negative.description: Optional negative prompt. Natural language. Omit when unused. Has little effect when CFG is 1.
